description: This file defines a function getTopQuotes that retrieves and prepares a list of top quotes from the database for display in a list view, along with helper functions for search criteria. It is part of the Quotes module in a SugarCRM-like system.

classes.name: Quotes
classes.description: A class representing the Quotes entity, used to generate list view entries.

methods.name: getTopQuotes
methods.description: Retrieves the top quotes from the database based on search criteria, pagination, and limits; returns an array with metadata and list entries.

methods.name: getTopQuotesSearch
methods.description: Prepares and encodes search criteria to filter quotes, focusing on stage and validity, for retrieving top quotes.
